patches.purpose: Install the legacy BST primary audio HAL and ALSA policy inherited by the Windows product
patches.quality: AOSP16 source SHA f4c2a5b71cda plus one Android 16 include-path adaptation
patches.impact: No runtime logic change; legacy HAL buffering and parser debt remain
patches.verification: audio.primary.bst focused build and Android-16 Windows 7/7 boot passed; playback/capture remains pending

patches.purpose: Provide camera.bst selected by the common product package list
patches.quality: AOSP16 source SHA a87e8be3bd35 adapted inline by mainline commits ccb6e51 and 33cdca5
patches.impact: No frame-path work added; uintptr_t fixes 64-bit queue pointer truncation
patches.verification: inline camera.bst 32/64 build and Android-16 Windows 7/7 boot passed; preview/capture remains pending

patches.purpose: Provide lights.bst selected by the Windows product
patches.quality: AOSP16 source SHA 31b9fb5f5e2e with an include-path adaptation only
patches.impact: No runtime behavior or steady-state cost added
patches.verification: lights.bst focused build and Android-16 Windows 7/7 boot passed; brightness exercise remains pending

patches.purpose: Provide the product-selected memtrack.bst compatibility module
patches.quality: AOSP16 source SHA b2aa1fc432d7 with include-path adaptations only
patches.impact: Negligible runtime cost; the inherited implementation reports no accounting data
patches.verification: memtrack.bst focused build and Android-16 Windows 7/7 boot passed; accounting fallback exercise remains pending

patches.purpose: Retain power.bst beside the Android 16 AIDL hint-session service
patches.quality: AOSP16 source SHA ff0cda46a0cf with include-path adaptations only
patches.impact: No hot-path change; inherited sysfs work occurs on interactive transitions
patches.verification: power.bst/AIDL service builds and Android-16 Windows 7/7 boot passed; suspend/resume remains pending

patches.purpose: Pin the ALSA configuration source consumed by the AOSP16 audio packaging flow
patches.quality: AOSP16 source SHA b881b3666a24; obsolete Android.mk is disabled on Android 16
patches.impact: No Android runtime module is introduced by the compatibility commit
patches.verification: Root gitlink/[A16] history audited and packaged image booted 7/7; audio behavior remains pending

patches.impact: No Android runtime module is introduced by the compatibility commit
